metadata.title: Never Say These 3 Words (Dark Psychology) #Shorts
metadata.description: Three everyday words quietly hand strangers power over you. Watch before your next conversation. #Shorts #DarkPsychology #PsychologyFacts

audio_profile.bg_music_vibe: minimal dark ambient pulse with sub drops

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Never say these three words again. Each one quietly costs you respect and power.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: lips speaking macro dark moody cinematic slow motion

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Word one. Sorry. Unearned apologies broadcast low status. Say thank you instead.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: hand writing letter paper pen macro moody warm light

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Thank you is gratitude. Sorry is surrender. People feel that difference instantly.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: firm handshake close up dark cinematic slow motion

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Word two. Just. I just think. I just feel. It quietly shrinks your authority.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: crumpled paper words text macro dark moody

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Delete it from your vocabulary. I think this. I know this. Same words. Completely different weight.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: confident speaker silhouette stage spotlight dramatic cinematic

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Word three. Whatever. It signals surrender. Silence looks far stronger.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: turning away silhouette fog dark street cinematic slow

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Hold steady eye contact. Say nothing at all. Watch who blinks first.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: steady eyes close up portrait dark dramatic lighting macro

video_pipeline.narration_audio_text: Speak less. Mean more. Follow for the words that winners never use.
video_pipeline.visual_generation_prompt: city night skyline dark towers lights cinematic slow zoom
